newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia peso extends gains, closes at 1,035.00.
newsitem.headline: Colombia peso extends gains, closes at 1,035.00.

text.p: Colombia's peso closed higher for the sixth consecutive day, ending up 4.4 pesos to the dollar at 1,035.00.
It was the peso's highest close in 24 days and came after a day of active trade in which interbank dealers reported 296 operations for a total of $118.3 million.

Dealers said the peso's gain was fueled, at least in part, by dollar sales by coffee and oil exporters. But one said support also came from about $7 million that entered the market from a foreign fund's recent investment in the supermarket chain Cadenalco.
The peso hit an intraday low of 1,039.80 before closing at the day's high.
